title: antirrhinum coulterianum subsp. orcuttianum
intro: Antirrhinum coulterianum subsp. orcuttianum, commonly known as the Coulter's Snapdragon, is a type of flowering plant in the snapdragon family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum coulterianum subsp. orcuttianum include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
